critique: The video asset is the strongest thing here — faceted low-poly deer in cobalt, vermilion and cadmium yellow grazing on a bleached salt flat under a pale peach dawn, with folded paper trees as the only vertical: genuinely high-key, genuinely Bauhaus in its primaries and clean planes, and the empty ground below the herd does real work. But the SVG layer betrays the brief entirely: three enormous cream-and-vermilion **koi** with forked tails and side fins are pasted over the deer at scales up to 400px wide, the aria-label describes koi "browsing among tall reeds," and a cartoon guinea pig sits in the corner — the deer are buried under a fish piece that has nothing to do with the assignment, so the finished page reads as the wrong animal in the wrong medium.
